name: Saint James Orchestra Soundfonts
description: 48 separate orchestral SF2 banks — violin, viola, cello and bass with arco, legato, detache, pizzicato and tremolo variants, plus brass, woodwinds, harp, piano and percussion. GPL-3.0; the repository is the distribution point, so this entry opens it rather than a single archive.

files.note: One repository with 49 .sf2 files; download the ones you need (or the repo zip) and load them as separate banks.
